messages:
sasha: Mulled cider + holiday croon-off this Fri 4pm in kitchen? Bring ugly sweaters & a mug. :tada: :musical_note:
devon: Love it. Is there a sign-up or just show up?
harper: I can bring a batch of non-alc mulled cider (and a spare kettle). Any spice preferences? cinnamon + star anise ok?
alex: I'll DJ. Anyone want to add song requests here? :headphones:
sasha: @alex add "All I Want for Christmas" to the danger zone. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
liam: Can we do a 2-min "office carols" rule so shy folks aren't on forever?
sasha: Yes — 2 min cap, judge-free zone. :sparkles:
maya: I'll make a tiny award — "Most Dramatic Entry" (it's a paper ribbon). :ribbon:
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: "Mulled Cider & Croon-Off" Fri 4:00 PM - 4:30 PM. RSVP in event.
devon: RSVP'd. bringing cookies? which type?
harper: Chocolate chip + one gluten-free batch. Labelled.
sneha: Bah humbug, but I'll come for the cookies. :cookie:
alex: Song requests: @sasha Danger Zone, @maya Silent Night (k?). add more pls
sasha: Also planning a tiny hot cocoa bar for non-cider folks. cocoa + peppermint + marshmallows.
maya: I'll print a sign: "Croon-off rules: 1) 2 min 2) no heckling 3) applause encouraged". Will stick to fridge.
liam: who wants to help with setup at 3:30?
devon: me
harper: me
ops-bot: Reminder will go out 1 hour before event.
sasha: perfect. see y'all Friday! :heart:
maya: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/holiday-sing-3o6ZtaO9BZHcOjmErm
liam: If weather is wild, we'll move to the big conference room. heads up channel then.
sneha: yayyyy :tada:
